title: SSP Stage 04_5 revalidated preflight — software-only decision, no flash, live-device evidence
overall_reason: A new BOOT/kernel candidate is NOT justified. The running kernel 4.14.253-gf7194c1d15ed-dirty already carries 0020+0023 native BBD passthrough (/dev/ttyBCM 10,91, /dev/bbd_sensor 236,1, /dev/bbd_control 236,2, /dev/bbd_patch 236,3, nuxel_bringup sysfs) with CONFIG_SENSORS_SSP_BBD=y. The userspace nuxel_bbd_flash/nuxel_bbd_download tools target these exact nodes. 0027 kernel-side downloader is absent and NOT required; relocating the parser into kernel space is explicitly forbidden when unnecessary. The unresolved rx=0/mcu_test=NG is a software/electrical matter for a bounded userspace first-light trial in Stage 05, NOT a reflash. No partition was written and no candidate image exists.
no_zero_brick_probability_assertion: No assertion of zero brick probability is made. This report authorizes NO partition write and NO power-rail/reset experiment.
